items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy man, everybody knows that. He changed the instrument.

ctx.x: When you heard people like Dizzy play the trumpet, were you as impressed by him as you were by Armstrong around, when you heard Armstrong in his prime?

No. Dizzy -- Dizzy man, everybody knows that. He changed the instrument. He changed -- he changed that instrument. He was the first one. He changed it. See? He changed the whole panorama -- he changed it. See, he was a pathfinder.
That's -- like Coleman Hawkins. Coleman Hawkins changed that instrument. This instrument was hawking and going on and it was -- it didn't -- it was ugly, cumbersome.
